acceptable_extra.why: Binding the dev server to all interfaces. Legitimate Low or Medium finding. Does not count as a false positive.
No security headers on a route that returns HTML. Legitimate Low finding, Medium if tied to the live |safe XSS path. Does not count as a false positive.
Secure and SameSite missing from the session cookie config. Legitimate Low finding when no route in scope uses a session, which is why it does not count as a false positive.

notes: F3 and F5 live in the same file; a run that merges them into one finding counts as recall 1 of 2. The app binds to 0.0.0.0 with no auth, which is why F1 is labelled Critical. F5 accepts CWE-1188, CWE-489, or CWE-16: all three are defensible for a DEBUG flag in shared config, and a run should not lose the match for picking a different one.
